verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe Repository Agent, a conversational AI assistant built into the app. It can browse files, search content, read and modify files, and commit, pull and push (docs-29). The homepage advertises a Code Agent with opt-in data handling (docs-64), and AI commit-message suggestions add a smaller AI feature (docs-37, docs-5). Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the agent's scope, limits, model/provider and approval controls, plus any independent or hands-on corroboration of the agent working in practice.
